description: Scoring computation runs on a background thread separate from the main thread and render thread

preconditions.description: The scoring engine is invoked as part of the advisory integration in provider-service

expectedOutcome.description: Scoring runs asynchronously without blocking the Tauri main thread or the frontend render thread, maintaining sub-100ms shell responsiveness

steps: Trigger a scoring computation via the advisory integration path
Verify the main thread event loop is not blocked during scoring
Verify UI interactions remain responsive (sub-100ms) while scoring runs
